dept_ta: சமூக நலம் மற்றும் மகளிர் உரிமைத் துறை
target_beneficiaries: Female heads of eligible households holding rice-allotted smart ration cards
eligibility: Annual family income < ₹2.5 Lakhs; Landholding < 5 acres wetland or 10 acres dryland; Annual electricity usage < 3,600 units.
benefits: ₹1,000 direct monthly cash assistance transferred directly into beneficiary bank accounts (DBT).
required_docs: Aadhaar Card, Smart Family Card (Ration Card), Bank Passbook linked to Aadhaar, Electricity Consumer Number.
application_method: Biometric registration at designated e-Sevai / Fair Price Shop special camps.

name_en: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education (Pudhumai Penn)
target_beneficiaries: Girl students studying in government schools from Classes 6 to 12 pursuing collegiate degrees
eligibility: Must have studied in Tamil Nadu government schools from 6th to 12th standard; Enrolled in undergraduate degree, diploma, or ITI courses.
benefits: ₹1,000 monthly financial incentive disbursed directly to students until completion of degree.
required_docs: School Transfer Certificate (TC) confirming government schooling, College Bonafide, Aadhaar, Bank Passbook.
application_method: Online registration through college nodal officer via Pudhumai Penn portal.
responsible_office: Directorate of Social Welfare, Panagal Maligai, Saidapet

name_en: Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme (Kaalai Unavu Thittam)
dept_ta: சமூக நலம் மற்றும் சத்துணவுத் திட்டத் துறை
target_beneficiaries: All children studying in Classes 1 to 5 across all government primary schools in Tamil Nadu
benefits: Nutritious, hot cooked breakfast served on all school working days (Pongal, Kichadi, Upma, Sambhar).
application_method: Universal coverage - No application form required.
responsible_office: Commissionerate of Municipal Administration & Social Welfare

target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens, bedridden patients, and citizens suffering from hypertension and diabetes
eligibility: Any resident of Tamil Nadu requiring routine non-communicable disease (NCD) screening or palliative care.
benefits: Free home delivery of blood pressure and diabetic drugs, dialysis support, physiotherapy and palliative care at home.
required_docs: Smart Family Card, Aadhaar Card, Previous Medical Reports.
application_method: Home visit by Women Health Volunteers (WHV) / Primary Health Centre (PHC) registration.
responsible_office: National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu, DMS Complex, Teynampet

target_beneficiaries: Victims of road traffic accidents within Tamil Nadu geographical territory (residents & non-residents)
eligibility: Any individual involved in a road traffic accident within the State, regardless of domicile or income.
benefits: Free emergency medical treatment up to ₹1,00,000 for the first 48 hours across 600+ empanelled government and private hospitals.
required_docs: Emergency admission handled by 108 Ambulance service / Hospital casualty.
application_method: Immediate cashless emergency hospital care on presentation.
responsible_office: Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project, DMS Annex, Chennai

name_en: Naan Mudhalvan - Skill Development and Employability
target_beneficiaries: College students, engineering and arts & science graduates, polytechnic diploma holders
eligibility: College students in Tamil Nadu state universities, autonomous colleges, and polytechnics.
benefits: Free industry-vetted technical courses (AI, Data Science, Cyber Security, Robotics, Spoken English, Competitive Exam Coaching).
required_docs: College Registration Number, Aadhaar Card, Email ID.
application_method: Online self-enrollment through official Naan Mudhalvan learning management platform.
responsible_office: Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation (TNSDC), Guindy

target_beneficiaries: Paddy and delta farmers in Cauvery delta and sub-basin districts
eligibility: Cultivating farmers owning or leasing agricultural wetland in delta and notified irrigation districts.
benefits: 100% subsidy on certified paddy seeds, chemical fertilizers, bio-fertilizers, and free agricultural power supply.
required_docs: Patta / Chitta copy, Aadhaar Card, Uzhavan App Registration, Bank Passbook.
application_method: Uzhavan Mobile App registration or through Agricultural Extension Centres (AEC).

name_en: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
target_beneficiaries: Destitute elderly individuals aged 60 and above with no major earning family members
eligibility: Age >= 60 years; Destitute with personal property assets < ₹50,000; Living below poverty line (BPL).
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,200 deposited into beneficiary bank account or door-delivered via postal money order.
required_docs: Aadhaar Card, Proof of Age (Voter ID / Birth Certificate), Income Certificate, Destitute Certificate, Smart Card.
application_method: Online submission via e-Sevai Centers or in person at Taluk Office (Social Security Scheme Wing).
responsible_office: Special Deputy Collector (Social Security Schemes), District Collectorates
